remarks: Tastefully renovated in 2016 with open & airy floor plan. Main level features living room w/bow window & hardwood floors open to dining room with sliders to large flagstone patio overlooking private backyard. Stunning kitchen with stainless appliances, quartz countertops, recessed & pendant lighting, subway tile back splash, & breakfast bar. Upstairs level features a gorgeous bathroom with dual entry and two sinks. All three bedrooms have hardwood floors. Tiled entry foyer, large family room with cherry plank flooring, and an updated bathroom. House is wired for high speed internet. Wonderful neighborhood with an old-fashioned, neighborly feel. Great location for walking or biking to town. Pet - will be considered case by case.
